scope: all accepted H twelve workflows; native function calls only; not provider responses or causal token attribution

method.scope: Native response_item function_call/custom_tool_call records only; no hidden reasoning; no provider generation, token retotal, active candidate cost or parked R analysis.
method.roles: Direct role .thread_id files cross-checked for consistent role; WL first native policy launch with its first owned Agent-ID footer, including separate linearizer policy prefix. Actual H policy source and no earlier AGENTS Agent-ID footer checked.
method.counts: One exact call_id per native function call; every exec joins a unique same-thread function_call_output. Leading executable and git second word are shlex lexical labels, not semantic command counts; unknown shell syntax is retained. Repeated commands are byte-identical cmd strings within one thread after the first occurrence.
method.bytes: Output UTF-8 bytes include native tool metadata wrapper and are not charged-token estimates; no whole-workflow comparison is inferred from native-only bytes.
method.polling: Every joined native exec output has a completed-process header. None has an asynchronous process-running header; no native write_stdin/wait tool is called.
method.source_validation: Every native source equals its observation rollout-metadata SHA; every source rehashed at census endpoint. Historical cohort and report identities retained.

mediated_command_scope: All 58 exact work-leaf command result inputs in H, using owned prefix and command/status header. All are author checks; source/public/archive equality is independently verified in EVIDENCE-H-CONTEXT.md. These are separate model-visible handoffs and are not native exec calls.
